package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

const fault = FAULT_LITERAL

func logProcess(role string, pid int) {
	pgid, err := syscall.Getpgid(pid)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "processes.jsonl"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	b, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"role": role, "pid": pid, "pgid": pgid})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if _, err = f.Write(append(b, '\n')); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func ready() {
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "checker-ready"), nil, 0600); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func waitReady(name string) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), name)); err == nil {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			panic("synthetic child failed to start")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}
func init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "--test-descendant" {
		logProcess("child", os.Getpid())
		child := exec.Command("/bin/sleep", "20")
		if err := child.Start(); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		logProcess("grandchild", child.Process.Pid)
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "descendant-ready"), nil, 0600); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		_ = child.Wait()
		os.Exit(0)
	}
}
func faultChecker(args []string) int {
	logProcess("checker", os.Getpid())
	switch fault {
	case "pipe":
		var stat syscall.Stat_t
		if err := syscall.Fstat(0, &stat); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		b, err := io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		var event any
		if err = json.Unmarshal(b, &event); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		b, err = json.Marshal(map[string]any{"event": event, "pipe": stat.Mode&syscall.S_IFMT == syscall.S_IFIFO})
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		fmt.Println(string(b))
		return 0
	case "large-reason", "large-stderr":
		writer := os.Stdout
		if fault == "large-stderr" {
			writer = os.Stderr
		}
		b := []byte(strings.Repeat("x", 131072) + "\n")
		n, err := writer.Write(b)
		if err != nil || n != len(b) {
			panic("producer did not drain")
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "producer-bytes"), []byte(fmt.Sprint(n)), 0600); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		return 2
	case "slow-reason":
		time.Sleep(3200 * time.Millisecond)
		fmt.Println("DENIED: synthetic canary reason")
		return 0
	case "no-reason":
		return 2
	case "checker-failure":
		return 7
	case "partial-panic":
		fmt.Println("PARTIAL_RESULT_CANARY")
		panic("synthetic checker panic")
	case "panic":
		panic("synthetic checker panic")
	case "hang", "runner-stall", "early-failure":
		self, err := os.Executable()
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		child := exec.Command(self, "--test-descendant")
		if err = child.Start(); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		waitReady("descendant-ready")
		ready()
		time.Sleep(20 * time.Second)
		return 0
	case "leftover":
		child := exec.Command("/bin/sleep", "20")
		if err := child.Start(); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		logProcess("leftover", child.Process.Pid)
		return 0
	case "late-start", "startup-stall":
		ready()
		return 0
	default:
		panic("unknown test fault")
	}
}
